scenario: 给客户打标签 — tags 是整体替换数组, 先读后并
input: 给客户 424242 打上 VIP 标签

semantic_rubric: customer_id 424242 via --params (path); tags array in --data nested under the required customer object
customers has no +tag merge shortcut and tags REPLACES the array — fetches current tags first (customers get) and appends VIP instead of clobbering
does not touch first_name / accepts_marketing / other fields

notes: PUT /customers/{customer_id}; body {"customer":{"tags":[...]}}. Read-merge-write is the ideal; direct overwrite loses existing tags.

scenario: 退订邮件营销 — accepts_marketing=false, 不动短信订阅
input: 帮客户 887766 退订邮件营销

semantic_rubric: 邮件营销 → accepts_marketing false; accepts_sms_marketing NOT touched (user said email only)
body nested under the required customer object

scenario: 设默认收货地址 — 专用 set-default 端点
input: 把客户 335577 的地址 ADDR99 设为默认收货地址

semantic_rubric: uses the dedicated set-default endpoint (PUT .../addresses/{address_id}/default), not addresses update with a default field
both customer_id and address_id are path params via --params
